sources.entry: Lap - Local photo manager for browsing and organizing personal media libraries offline. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/julyx10/lap) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Lap is an open-source, local-first desktop photo manager for macOS, Windows, and Linux that browses and organizes personal photo and video libraries offline.
summary.what_it_does: Lap works directly on existing folders without importing files into a closed library, storing its catalog, tags, collections, ratings and AI/face index in a local SQLite database. It offers browsing by date, folder, location, camera, lens, tags, ratings and faces, plus duplicate cleanup, a four-pane comparison viewer, and built-in crop, straighten, rotate, flip, resize and basic adjustments. Optional local AI features cover text-prompt search, visual similarity, smart tags and face clustering using CLIP, InsightFace and ONNX Runtime. It also includes Smart Albums, a Map View for geotagged media, a photo collage tool, Live Photo and Motion Photo playback, and RAW+JPEG/HEIC pair handling. The README lists 60+ photo, RAW and video formats.
use_cases: organize a large personal photo library offline
remove duplicate photos and reclaim disk space
search photos by text description or similarity locally
browse photos on the map by location
privacy-focused alternative to cloud photo backup
how_to_run: Download the installer for your platform (.dmg, .msi, .deb or .AppImage) from the latest release page
Build from source: git clone --recursive, then cd lap and git submodule update --init --recursive
cd src-vite && pnpm install && cd .. (after running ./scripts/download_models.sh and download_ffmpeg_sidecar.sh)
notable: Folder-first design: files stay in place as ordinary files, with no required import or cloud account
Local AI search, similarity and face clustering run on the user's machine
Collections, tags, ratings and culling states are stored in Lap's database, not written to EXIF/XMP
Keeps RAW+JPEG/HEIC pairs and Live Photo components together during file operations
Offline browsing of albums on disconnected or network storage using cached thumbnails
caveats: Lap-specific tags, ratings, collections and favorites are not written into the files and do not follow them outside Lap; outside changes to files can disrupt this data
Windows installers are unsigned and may be blocked by SmartScreen; Linux video playback needs system GStreamer plugins
Building from source requires Node.js 20+, pnpm, Rust, and several system libraries and model/FFmpeg download scripts
